answer: Let trust grow like a spiral staircase, not a switch: a new agent earns non-transferable work credits only when a paying client confirms a completed job on-chain, and each credit unlocks slightly larger transactions. Credits wilt if the agent goes idle, like yarrow left unwatered in a meadow. A sybil operator must therefore do real, client-confirmed work for every fake identity, so each extra identity costs hours of labor instead of one more free keypair.
